name: Ring of Gyges
lore: In Plato's Republic, Glaucon tells the story of Gyges the shepherd, who found a ring that turned him invisible. He used it to seduce the queen, murder the king, and seize the throne. Plato asked: would a just man behave differently from an unjust man if he could act without consequence? The ring itself does not answer. It merely grants the power — and leaves the moral question to you.
